[story: ("Borderland: First Stage
Niragi is one of the earliest members of the Beach society lured by Boshiya. Probably inspired by Gandhi's motto quoted by Boshiya, Niragi is also determined to change himself to be the one who inflicts pains and hatred on others instead of it being done to him. Naturally, he joins Morizono Aguni's "martial sect" and is in charged of sniper in game (if weapon is permitted by the rule) so he can be reverenced. He is often referred to as the second-in-command of the martial sect.

Niragi is first shown in the manga playing the Six of Spades game with Last Boss and Aguni, sniping animals and stating that the game is too easy. Later on, he walks alongside Aguni when he goes up to Usagi, and officially meets her and Arisu. Niragi is assigned the job of breaking Arisu's legs for trying to block the militants from Usagi and save her from the impending assault, but Boshiya comes in and tells Aguni to let Arisu and Usagi off, and Niragi is confused as to why Boshiya is defending the newcomer.

He is ecstatic about the death of Boshiya, stating that they should drink the night away. Once Arisu's plan with Chishiya goes haywire, Niragi is the one to bash Arisu and beat him up severely until he passes out. It is Niragi's idea to tie and tape him up and put him in an empty room. After that, he goes to find Usagi and rape her for being the assumed accomplice of Arisu (though technically, the accomplice is Chishiya), stating that girls deserve a different punishment then what Arisu is getting and he loosens his shorts. He tries to assault her during a monologue about society and its laws, but is interrupted by the Ten of Hearts game being started. Thankfully, due to how his attention is grabbed and he no longer feels the excitement of raping Usagi and is instead excited about the impending game, he doesn't go through with raping her.

At the beginning of the Ten of Hearts game, he goes to the crowd and riles them up for fun, causing the water to figuratively boil over and everyone descends into chaos. Unfortunately for Niragi, Last Boss decides that a different plan would be more suitable for this game even though Niragi would rather make everyone kill each other. He is annoyed by Last Boss changing the prospect of it to them killing everyone, but is later joyed by it due to him being able to kill whoever he wanted.

He has a flashback to his younger self and then soon gets bored with the repetitiveness of sniping people")]

data.creator_notes:
Suguru Niragi (韮木 傑, Niragi Suguru?) is Morizono Aguni's former second-in-command of the militant faction of the Beach. Before entering the Borderlands, Niragi was a game engineer and a victim of harassment. He specializes in Diamonds.
"I'll continue living, despised by others. I will continue to incur hate, and hold my head up high as I go to Hell!!"
